parameter_semantics: destination_object selects the currently observed hole_pose as the moving Cartesian reference. held_object selects the currently observed peg_pose for grasp and alignment features. Both are semantic scene identifiers, not actuator values.
output_semantics: Each slot is an absolute TCP target expressed in the freshly observed destination/hole frame: translation xyz in metres, rotation as the first two columns of a relative rotation matrix (6D), then the native gripper scalar. The decoder projects 6D to SO(3), left-composes the current world_T_hole at that execution step, and invokes panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured qpos. Prediction slots are t-1 through t+14; execution uses slots 1 through 8. No scripted task motion is added.

conversion_check.description: For valid demonstration labels, hole_T_tcp is reconstructed (with the 6D SO(3) projection), transformed by the matching observed world_T_hole, and solved by shared IK. Compare FK TCP position, rotation angle, and unchanged gripper scalar to the demonstrated commanded target; nonunique joints are allowed.

cut_relation: Uses all assigned [start,stop) actions for every trajectory, including the complete [1380,1500) incoming overlap, and changes only the Cartesian coordinate representation and causal conditioning.
